rules.C01: Every metric has an explicit owner, exam, population/manifest, reset epoch, date window, timezone, evidence watermark, evaluation time and completeness. Never reconcile by max().
rules.C02: Selection and save/acknowledgement are not grading. One committed nonblank response per session item contributes once. Graded blanks affect examination score, not answered learning.
rules.C03: Keep canonical question identity separate from revision, membership, item instance, response, operation and session identities. Pin all historical configuration at start.
rules.C04: Derive first/repeat from canonical response history before date filtering. Default basis is lifetime; reset-relative first is a different named metric. Unknown provenance remains unknown.
rules.C05: Single-select grading is correct/incorrect/unanswered over pinned items. Compare exact counts with the pinned site practice target before rounding. Unknown target or denominator is unavailable.
rules.C06: Retain the measured baseline mastery coefficients and per-question rounding; aggregate without further intermediate rounding. Distinguish raw/weighted coverage, mastery, readiness, due and notebook counts.
rules.C07: Timed sessions use an authoritative unchanged deadline, continue hidden/offline, and cannot pause. Active visible question time is separate, includes revisits and known zeros, excludes hidden/paused time.
rules.C08: Use explicit legal session transitions. Finalization freezes inputs; a storage/network failure is not completion. Completed, expired and abandoned are terminal.
rules.C09: Authorize owner first. Identical operation retry returns the original receipt without side effects. Conflicting ID reuse, stale revision or stale writer cannot overwrite canonical state.
rules.C10: New-only excludes lifetime reservations/delivery/display/answers. Abandonment and adaptive reset do not release those exclusions. Offline allocation requires an already valid reservation.
rules.C11: Adaptive reset creates a new server epoch without erasing lifetime evidence or examination scores. Old-epoch work remains old-epoch; account deletion is a separate authorized workflow.
rules.C12: Cloud accepted means an explicit operation receipt, not a green connection. Synced-as-of requires acknowledged relevant operations and complete catch-up to a declared server watermark.
rules.C13: Activity uses qualified answer timestamps in an explicit account reporting timezone; window is half-open. Complete history/export is independent of caches; missing dates/durations are never fabricated.
rules.C14: These are new logical contracts, not additional values permitted in the deployed SQL event enum. Legacy adapters preserve original bytes/provenance and unknowns; unsupported versions fail visibly.
rules.C15: The 100-point rubric is fixed before implementation outcomes. Missing evidence or any release blocker cannot be averaged away. Review/merge/deployment/production verification are separate.

scope.timeZoneSelection: Use account-saved IANA timezone; UTC is an explicit labelled fallback, not device-local inference.

legacyMappings.session_started: Start/planned item list; not proof each item was displayed.
legacyMappings.question_exposed: Conservative delivery exclusion; actual display remains unknown absent independent evidence.
legacyMappings.answer_recorded: Keep original. Do not count each edit as an independent retrieval. Reconcile with session/item/final snapshot in Segment 08.
legacyMappings.session_completed: Use immutable answer snapshot as final exam score source; include blanks; validate duplicate IDs and pinned/unknown configuration.
legacyMappings.session_abandoned: No examination completion; retain already graded adaptive responses and durable drafts distinctly.

evidence.epochResetEnvelope: For learning_epoch_reset only, sessionId, writerEpoch and expectedSessionRevision are null; resetEpochId names the expected current epoch for server compare-and-swap.

mastery.aggregateRounding: display only; no intermediate domain/coverage rounding
mastery.missingRecency: unavailable; never pretend an invented age
mastery.missingBlueprint: invalid; never silently substitute equal weights
mastery.priority: normalized domain weight * (100 - unrounded domain readiness); not benefit per study hour

time.clockRecovery: Use calibrated server time plus monotonic elapsed in-process. Offline restart without trusted elapsed requires recovery; never extend the deadline.
time.activeTime: sum of deduplicated non-overlapping visible in-progress visits, clipped to deadline; hidden/paused excluded
time.averageDenominator: distinct items with known active duration, including known zero
time.expiryOffline: freeze local snapshot, show provisional result pending server acceptance; one canonical terminal record after reconciliation

retention.cloudEvidence: retain until explicit authorized deletion or a separately approved retention policy
retention.pendingLocalEvidence: never silently evict; original owner only; disclose browser eviction/storage failure boundary
retention.oldEpochUpload: may be accepted for original valid session/epoch; never contributes to new epoch
retention.privacyDeletion: separate authenticated, auditable deletion/tombstone protocol; no resurrection by old offline clients

syncedConditions: all pages through server watermark applied
sync.cursorBasis: server commit sequence; not client event time
